Engaged Capital Decreased Its Ncr New (NCR) Holding by $3.42 Million as Valuation Declined; Apple (AAPL) Share Value Rose While Hedeker Wealth Management Group Has Boosted Holding
June 10, 2018 - By Stephen Andrade
Glenn W. Welling decreased its stake in Ncr Corp New (NCR) by 31.39% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Engaged Capital Llc sold 110,313 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.90% with the market. The hedge fund run by Glenn W. Welling held 241,154 shares of the office equipment and supplies and services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $7.60M, down from 351,467 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Engaged Capital Llc who had been investing in Ncr Corp New for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $3.69 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.83% or $0.26 during the last trading session, reaching $31.15. About 879,268 shares traded. NCR Corporation (NYSE:NCR) has declined 27.27% since June 10, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 39.84% the S&P500. Hedeker Wealth Management Group Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 10.29% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hedeker Wealth Management Group Llc bought 3,379 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 36,230 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $6.08 million, up from 32,851 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hedeker Wealth Management Group Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $942.23B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.91% or $1.76 during the last trading session, reaching $191.7. About 26.47M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 10, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500. Analysts await NCR Corporation (NYSE:NCR) to report earnings on July, 19. They expect $0.63 earnings per share, down 21.25% or $0.17 from last year’s $0.8 per share. NCR’s profit will be $74.53M for 12.36 P/E if the $0.63 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.56 actual earnings per share reported by NCR Corporation for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 12.50% EPS growth.
